   MINUTES OF THE SPECIAL MEETING
  NORWALK COMMUNITY PROMOTION COMMISSION
  DECEMBER 16, 2024

Chair Leon called the meeting to order at 6:00 p.m. Responding to roll call were Vice Chair Ang and
Commissioner Sanchez. Commissioner Beacham was absent. Also present was Alex Ocegueda,
Office Assistant III, Jocelyn Hernandez, Communications Specialist, and Jonathan Gonzalez,
Community Information Assistant.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES

Commissioner Sanchez made the motion and Chair Leon seconded to approve the minutes for
November 18, 2024. There being no objection, the motion carried.

REPORTS

Holiday Home and Business Décor Contest

Mrs. Ocegueda provided Commissioners the scoring sheets and map of the contest participants. Mrs.
Ocegueda went over the judging timeline and asked Commissioners to bring their finalized scoring
sheets with them to the January meeting. Chair Leon asked if the Commissioner’s promoting efforts
with the door hangers helped with submissions. Mrs. Ocegueda stated she did receive calls from
residents asking if the door hanger was actually associated with the City. Mrs. Ocegueda did receive
the bulk of the submissions after the door hangers were distributed and the Commissioner’s promotion
effort at the Tree Lighting Ceremony.

Business Spotlight

Miss Hernandez showed the “Keeping It Norwalk” Campaign, the November Small Businesses edition
to Commissioners. Mrs. Ocegueda provided Commissioners with the 2025 monthly Business Spotlight
themes for their review. After discussion, Commissioners approved the list. Commissioner Sanchez
asked if there is a way to alert businesses of the topics each month. Mrs. Ocegueda stated she shares
the information with the Chamber of Commerce to announce in their weekly newsletter but is looking
into possibly having the Business Spotlight in the Business Bulletin Newsletter that is published and
mailed every month to all businesses in Norwalk by the Public Safety Department. All Commissioners
asked Mrs. Ocegueda to add the theme selection to their discussion at the July meeting so they can
help provide themes for the following year. Vice Chair Ang would like to discuss at future meetings the
possibility of having a digital business directory.

Communications and Public Affairs Analytics

Miss Hernandez provided the analytics and explained Key Performance Indicators (KPI) and the city’s
overall reach across all outreach platforms for the last month. Chair Leon asked if the City’s new
website had been promoted. Mrs. Ocegueda stated it was announced in the Norwalk Now.
Commissioners commented that links/forms on the city website were not mobile friendly. Vice Chair
Ang suggested creating a video encouraging viewers to subscribe to the City’s YouTube page as other
influencers do.
 Minutes of the Special Meeting
Community Promotion Commission
December 16, 2024

STAFF COMMENTS:

Mrs. Ocegueda provided Commissioners with the 2025 list of meetings and events they are expected
to be in attendance. Mrs. Ocegueda also informed the Commission that Commissioner Beacham
officially resigned from her position. Mrs. Ocegueda also reminded the Commission to reach out to
their appointed Councilmember/City Clerks office to get reappointed to the Commission by March 2025
as their appointments expire on December 31, 2024.

COMMISSIONERS COMMENTS:

Vice Chair Ang stated he would be attending the December 17th City Council meeting along with other
individuals to support the 605 All Star Band participating in the Rose Parade to request funding.
Councilmember Valencia stated that the funding has already been raised and the band will be able to
have their practice walk as requested. Commissioner Ang informed the Commission that he has a
friend who owns a boutique that is willing to work with them on consignment to provide Norwalk branded
merchandise for sale. Councilmember Valencia commented that other members of the Council have
also been interested in selling Norwalk branded merchandise but thinks we should maybe reach out to
companies that the City has already worked with and compare. Mrs. Ocegueda stated staff will keep
researching and provide updates at the next meeting. Commissioner Sanchez stated he would be
attending the Rose Parade to support the 605 All Star Band. Commissioner Sanchez also commented
on attending the Reorganization meeting as his role of President of the Arturo Sanchez Sr. Halloween
Parade Foundation to donate a check to the Public Safety Cadet program as requested by the outgoing
Mayor and also assisted in the survey/décor contest promotion at the Tree Lighting Ceremony. Chair
Leon stated she also assisted at the Tree Lighting Ceremony and was pleased with the turn-out and
participation they received in the survey, commenting that the bags they were giving out helped in
getting residents’ attention. Chair Leon also attended the Reorganization meeting and although it was
a great event, felt the meeting itself ran too long.

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

Councilmember Valencia commented she was glad to have attended today’s meeting and glad she
was able to provide positive information about the band’s parade funding. Councilmember Valencia
also stated that applications have been received for open Commission positions and hopes that will
help in filling in the vacancies that currently exist in the Community Promotion Commission.
Councilmember Valencia wished everyone Happy Holidays and passed out her holiday postcards.
Resident Jack stated he was glad he was sit in the meeting and learn more about the Commission and
their goals. Resident Jack is excited to hear about the possibility of seeing Norwalk branded
merchandise in the future and stated he like the “Straight Outta Norwalk” design he noticed at the
Halloween Parade that was worn by another resident.

ADJOURNMENT

There being no further business, the meeting was adjourned at 7:40 p.m.
